found: 「MOMINOKI HOUSEでは農家さんにスタッフが直接問い合わせるなど、お客様に安心していただけるよう安全確認も行っております。」 and 「1976年、東京・原宿に日本で初めての自然食レストラン「MOMINOKI HOUSE」をオープンし…」 (オーナーシェフ 山田英知郎).
note: Close but reworded by the site: it is STAFF who contact farmers directly, under an owner-chef. Repair the wording rather than deleting it.

Real, trading, well-documented venue (MOMINOKI HOUSE, 渋谷区神宮前2-18-5, open since 1976, Mon closed, Tue-Sat 11:00-15:00/17:00-22:00, Sun+holidays 11:00-21:00) whose evidence was simply never cited — every claim is repairable from the venue's own site. Four data defects to fix alongside the citations: (1) the record's name field is 「玄米菜食」, a cuisine phrase, not the venue name モミノキハウス / MOMINOKI HOUSE; (2) neighborhood reads 青山 but the address is 神宮前 (Harajuku); (3) hours_raw says 'Hours unverified' although the site publishes them; (4) NOT IN THE RECORD AT ALL — the concept page states the shop refuses entry to customers who have had a replicon COVID vaccine (「レプリコンワクチンを接種したお客様のご来店をお断りすることにしました」). A traveller routed here should know that before they arrive.

why: The venue's own site publishes a named 「グルテンフリー・五葷抜き / Gluten-Free」 menu section with six priced items, in Japanese, English and Chinese. Under REVIEW_PROTOCOL that is 'some naturally-GF/adaptable dishes, NO special handling' — options, and capped there because it is a single source with no independent corroboration and no dedicated fryer claimed. The mandatory cross-contamination text must say: the same kitchen deep-fries wheat spring rolls and tempura, one GF-line item (揚げ餅) is itself deep-fried, the mock-meat karaage is seitan (the venue's own English menu calls it 'gluten chicken'), and neither tamari nor the miso type is stated.

vegan_status 'options' is correct and well evidenced — ヴィーガン寿司 ¥5,000, ヴィーガンディナースペシャル ¥6,800 and miso soup on a stated vegetable stock, in a kitchen that also serves mackerel, Ezo venison, organic chicken, sea-urchin pasta and cream-cheese pasta. No tier change. But vegan_label reads 'Fully vegan' and index.html renders that string as the list badge and the Vegan panel headline, so this omnivore restaurant currently displays as fully vegan.
